title: Patient Payment Plan Installments Added for the Care of the Latest Add-On
content:
When a **Patient Payment Plan** installment is recomputed after added balances, the extended schedule also gains installments for the care the most recent add-on brought. The class of care is the patient class of the hospital account in the Hospital Account (Encounter Billing) that the latest add-on enrolled.

**Rule.** The extended schedule gains 3 installments when the account of the latest add-on enrollment entry (the latest posting date other than the offered date, the first listed among entries of that date) is a Recurring Outpatient Therapy Account; 2 installments when it is an Inpatient Admission Account or an Observation Stay Account; and none otherwise, including when no add-on entry exists.

| Account class of the latest add-on entry | Installments gained |
|---|---|
| Recurring Outpatient Therapy Account | 3 |
| Inpatient Admission Account | 2 |
| Observation Stay Account | 2 |
| Outpatient Clinic Visit, Outpatient Diagnostic Imaging & Lab, Emergency Department Visit or Outpatient Surgery Account | none |
| no enrollment after the offered date | none |

**Hypothetical.** Add-on entries on 4 May (an Emergency Department Visit Account) and on 19 August (first listed an Observation Stay Account, then a Recurring Outpatient Therapy Account): the latest date is 19 August and its first listed entry is the Observation Stay Account, so the schedule gains 2.
